services.desc: Take off from Berkeley County Airport and dive into the adventure of a lifetime with iSkydive Charleston. With Charleston’s historic skyline in the distance, every jump delivers heart-pounding thrills and jaw-dropping views you won’t find anywhere else. Your skydive will go down in history as one of your most thrilling days. An experience you’ll want to relive.
